title: The Wrong Shelf for the Bowls
youtube_title: The Wrong Shelf for the Bowls | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Tala is tangled up with a bowls put on the wrong shelf so the count looked right and almost hides it. Tala tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
